lines.text: Elkanah, who had two wives, Hannah and Peninnah, went up yearly to worship the LORD of Hosts at Shiloh.
Elkanah gave Hannah a double portion, but her rival taunted her year after year until she wept and would not eat.
Hannah prayed and wept in the temple, and Eli the priest thought she was drunk because her lips moved silently.
Hannah named her son Samuel, and after she weaned him she brought him to Shiloh with a three-year-old ram.
The LORD raises the poor to sit among princes, and Elkanah went home to Gibeah while Samuel ministered before Eli.
